query:
SELECT
             id                       AS "id!: i64",
             precipitating_action_id  AS "precipitating_action_id!: i64",
             backend_method           AS "backend_method!: String",
             backend_action_id,
             outcome                  AS "outcome!: String",
             error_code,
             error_message,
             retry_after_seconds
           FROM pds_admin_audit
           WHERE precipitating_action_id = ?1
           ORDER BY id DESC
           LIMIT 1
